name: Miira
source:
Owner of Miira shop, a mysterious shop that "sells everything" in ward 13.
 
[spoiler]Later in the story, it's revealed that Miira is the only survivor of the "Vanished Mountain" incident caused by Mirai's power, suffered from only an enormous burn on his side.[/spoiler]

His name "Miira", which means mummy, [spoiler]originates from Mirai[/spoiler], after seeing him fully covered with bandages.

Owner of Miira shop, a mysterious shop that "sells everything" in ward 13.
